newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares up on week in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares up on week in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares rose in the week ended on Friday on the Beirut Stock exchange and dealers said positive mid-year results reported by the company attracted investors.
A shares rose 1.34 percent to $113 from last Friday's $111.5 and B shares were also up 1.73 percent to $117.125 from $115.125.

SOLIDERE, Lebanon's biggest company which is rebuilding central Beirut, announced on Tuesday net profit of $20.5 million for the first half of 1996 compared with $12.6 million for the same period last year. It had 1995 profit of $32.3 million.
"The positive results of SOLIDERE have attracted investors," one dealer told Reuters.
Another dealer said the company "is a real good value, that's why people are buying."
Weekly turnover rose to 38,636 shares from 37,091 last week, and value was $4,352,955.125 from $4,133,652.25.
There was no trade for the second sucessive week in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.45 percent to 84.41 and the BLOM stock index rose 1.29 percent to 979.40.
